text:
Maria: Quick sync — preview schedule & lead routing for next week's product launch webinar. Need X + LinkedIn post copy + 2 assets (carousel + 1-min clip). Targeting SMB dev teams. Thoughts?
Ajay: Love it. Can we do A/B on the hook? Variant A: 'Ship production-grade LLMs' Variant B: 'Cut inference costs by 3x'
Sam: I'll draft both hooks and 3 tweet-thread bullets. Who owns the video clip? @Leo?
Leo: I got the raw demo. Can export 60s clip — need highlight timestamps. Suggest 00:18-00:38 (throughput demo), 00:39-00:52 (latency graphs).
Maria: Perfect. Also need OG image + carousel frames (4). Scheduling proposal: X posts on launch day at 09:00 / 13:00 / 17:00 PT, LinkedIn at 09:30 / 15:00 PT. OK for APAC?
Ajay: Add one evening post to hit APAC — schedule 23:00 PT (morning APAC). I'll map timezones and confirm.
inbound-bot: New lead form submissions will be auto-tagged #launch-webinar and routed to SDR queue 'webinar-sdr'.
Sam: CTA variations: 1) Sign up (primary), 2) Watch recording (gated), 3) Request demo (sales). Recommend primary CTA = Sign up + track via UTM: utm_campaign=launch_mar2026&utm_source=organic
Maria: Who's owning scheduling in Buffer/Hub? @Nina_marketing
Nina_marketing: On it. Need final copy + assets by EOD Tuesday to set up drafts and A/B tests on X.
Leo: Working on the clip export now, will upload to Drive when ready: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/video_clip_v2.mp4
Ajay: :thumbsup: I'll share 3 headline variants by EOD.
Sam: Also planning a short follow-up thread after the webinar: 1) key benchmark metrics 2) customer quote 3) CTA. Route follow-up inbound leads to 'webinar-sdr-fup' list.
Maria: Nice. Final ask — react with :white_check_mark: once assets are uploaded so we can lock schedule. Thanks everyone!
